name: Skull Rock
summary: Burning Blade cultists gather at Skull Rock, hidden in Durotar's eastern coastal cliffs. Their cavern lies east of Orgrimmar, where they plot against Thrall's Horde.

sections.title: A Den of Cultists
sections.body: Burning Blade cultists gather in Skull Rock, a perilous stronghold beneath northeastern Durotar's crags. Dark cultists, fel-worshipping orcs, and summoners meet in its winding tunnels to practice demonic arts and plot against the young Horde. The warlock Gazz'uz leads the cell. Its work threatens Orgrimmar's nearby gates and travelers along the eastern shore.

faq.answer: Skull Rock is a cave system along the coast of northeastern Durotar. Burning Blade cultists use its natural cover to plot against Thrall's Horde.
The Burning Blade cult controls Skull Rock, led by the orc warlock Gazz'uz from the cave's deepest chamber.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this cave?
faq.answer: Skull Rock lies close to Orgrimmar, making the cave a serious threat to the Horde's security. The Burning Blade seeks to undermine Thrall's new realm and return the orcs to demonic servitude.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can see the demonic influence spreading through Skull Rock, which Thrall's Horde seeks to root out and control.
As a member of the Horde, you know clearing Skull Rock's cultists helps secure Durotar's coastal approaches and protect Orgrimmar from subversion within.
